tool.name: Aggregate readouts
tool.command:
mkdir -p pycytominer_output &&
## Convert the input to CSV for pycytominer #if $profiles.ext in ["tsv", "tabular"] python '$__tool_directory__/format_converter_csvtsv.py' -i '$profiles' -o 'profiles.csv' -c tsv2csv && #else cp '$profiles' 'profiles.csv' && #end if
## The strata parameter is a list of column indices; resolve them to header names strata_headers=\$(head -n1 'profiles.csv' | cut -d, -f'$strata') &&
pycytominer aggregate --profiles 'profiles.csv' --output_file 'pycytominer_output/output.csv' --output_type 'csv' --strata "\$strata_headers" --operation '$operation' &&
## Convert the result back to TSV for the Galaxy dataset python '$__tool_directory__/format_converter_csvtsv.py' -i 'pycytominer_output/output.csv' -o '$output' -c csv2tsv

param.name: profiles
param.label: Input feature-readouts table
param.help: Table with features extracted from images

param.name: strata
param.label: Aggregation columns
param.help: Select column names to aggregate by (e.g., Metadata_Plate, Metadata_Well)

tool.help:
**Collapses single-cell readouts (rows) into one representative profile per well.**
The readouts (rows) are collapsed by taking the median (or mean) of each feature across all cells in that well.
Documentation: https://pycytominer.readthedocs.io/en/stable/walkthroughs/pycytominer_cli.html#Step-1:-Aggregate
